GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (1 Apr 46) LS
(SCAPIN-850)
APO 500
1 April 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 1 December 1945, file and subject as above, wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one OMURA, Toshio, 1st Lt., to the Commanding General, XI Corps, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said OMURA's name. This name appears in Paragraph No. 6, 1st name, page No. 5 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General.
